summary: Hawkeye Systems Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Subscription Agreement with Hawkeye Holdco LLC for the sale of a warrant to purchase 221,878,595 common shares at $0.01 per share, exercisable until March 31, 2027. Separately, a Convertible Promissory Note principal of $2,767,756 was converted at $0.12/share into 23,064,634 shares, and a mandatory conversion of Series A Preferred Stock yielded 13,000,000 shares to Steve Hall. All securities were issued under Section 4(a)(2) exemptions. This is a standard equity financing and convertible note conversion, not a special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
